character.name: Abby
character.identityRule: Use 0_Abby_Avatar as the canonical avatar system. Use the approved frontal close-up and Final Avatar deck face studies as visual identity authority; exclude the rejected Blender and Cinema 4D diagnostic close-ups. Use the explicitly approved main-animation outfit render as the wardrobe authority for expression and performance mockups. Exclude 2_Record_Cover because it predominantly contains another avatar; retain only the explicitly approved Button avatar.

renders.label: Cinema 4D 1:1 animated match
renders.description: The actual Face Archetype Skeleton Sequence 1 facial take retargeted onto the recovered Cinema 4D 1:1 look-match. The native capture drives Abby's eyes, lids, brows, cheeks, jaw and lips while the look-development body, hair and camera remain fixed.
renders.fidelity: Direct facial-only retarget from the native 300-frame, 30 fps FBX take. The derived C4D scene contains 1,594,800 captured facial keys across 843 matched FACIAL_* controls; the browser preview renders every source frame at 30 fps and 480 × 270 through a fixed face-close review camera. Canonical face and eyelash weights are restored, the earlier wide render and exploratory scenes are archived, and the original C4D master remains untouched.

renders.label: Delighted Side Glance · Cinema 4D
renders.view: Material Closeup B camera · parallel upper-right glance
renders.renderType: Hand-authored MetaHuman joint pose on intact 1:1 look-development master
renders.description: Delighted Side Glance evaluated on Abby's intact production C4D master with the approved compact chin, raised upper teeth, parallel gaze, exact 1:1 wind-swept copper hair and untouched source skin. The v17 proof keeps v7's 0 EV exposure and 3.28 area key, then adds restrained diffuse-only Redshift fill to recover the face beneath the full hair.
renders.sourceUrlLabel: Open v7 · v16 · v17 fill comparison
renders.fidelity: Rendered read-only from the intact 1:1 material master with its original 66,348-point, 66,288-polygon Hair object, Clay_Hair material and complete Redshift plus Magic Bullet Looks chain. The selected v17 proof preserves v7's literal 0 EV camera exposure and 3.28 area key. Its Redshift dome is raised from 0.856 to 1.25 as fill, with reflection contribution disabled so the face opens without recreating v15's specular clipping. Abby_Face remains untouched and the source scene remains unsaved.

renders.label: Spin frame 170 · C4D Redshift v6
renders.renderType: Blender Spin body and facial motion transferred onto the intact C4D 1:1 look-development rig
renders.description: Complete 366-frame Blender Spin motion transfer onto Abby's accepted C4D rig. Version 78 preserves the v6 Redshift materials, skin, eyes, lashes, wardrobe, shoes and exact 1:1 copper hair while applying the source body motion, compact hand articulation, cached facial surface motion, blinks, eye direction and jaw motion for the full 0–365 take.
renders.fidelity: The eight-joint, 28-distance normalized body signature matches Blender frame 170 with a maximum absolute difference of 0.00000288. The intact C4D master supplies all renderable geometry and materials; its saved look take, 66,348-point / 66,288-polygon Hair object, Clay_Hair material, skin, eyes, lashes, wardrobe and Redshift chain remain in place. Version 78 renders the complete 0–365 body driver plus source-space facial and eyelash point caches, native C4D eye controls and lower-teeth jaw follow. All 366 PNGs and the 12.2-second H.264 encode passed full decode QA with zero missing frames and zero retries. The source Blender and C4D files remain untouched and every output is versioned.

rigGuide.purpose: Transfer Wonder Studio body motion and Unreal facial capture to Abby.
rules: Clothes and hair can be removed.
Hair curves and guides are included for Houdini simulation.
Generate Quick Rig only when control-rig cleanup is needed.

rigGuide.label: Quick Rig
rigGuide.purpose: Animation from scratch and control-rig editing.
rules: Includes rig controls when generated through Auto-Rig Pro Quick Rig.
Use the UE Metahuman preset and Preserve option.
Do not use this file as the retarget source.

rigGuide.label: C4D material master
rigGuide.purpose: Canonical C4D face, hair, outfit and material reference.
rules: Use the new direct Redshift look-match as the reproducible face and material reference.
Keep the archived renders beside it as provenance for the recovered framing.
Use the approved frontal close-up and Final Avatar deck studies for face identity; do not reinstate the rejected Blender or Cinema 4D diagnostic close-ups.
Keep the source file untouched; render only a disposable derived scene with Cinema 4D Commandline.

rigGuide.label: C4D native facial-mocap retarget
rigGuide.purpose: Native 10-second Face Archetype Skeleton Sequence 1 mocap take retargeted onto the recovered 1:1 face and Redshift look-match.
rules: This is a derived animation source; Abby_BaseMesh_Materials.c4d remains untouched.
Facial and eyelash weights were restored from the canonical Blender retarget master where the C4D export contained the hierarchy but no effective face weights.
The animation is transferred directly from Face_Archetype_Skeleton_Sequence1.FBX; it is not reconstructed from the slide render.
Retarget only the FACIAL_* hierarchy so the source body's incompatible rest pose cannot displace Abby's 1:1 body, hair or camera.

rigGuide.label: C4D Delighted Side Glance pose
rigGuide.purpose: Reusable one-frame production-rig transfer of the approved Delighted Side Glance expression.
rules: Use the 28 keyed transform channels on 21 FACIAL_* controls plus the head control as the expression layer; the named EXP_DELIGHTED_SIDE_GLANCE_V4 marker identifies the pose scene.
Copy or merge the facial keys into the target animation shot while leaving the body, wardrobe, hair and material systems on their production sources.

Use the v17 read-only master proof for visual approval: it retains the exact 1:1 Hair object and Clay_Hair material, uses Material Closeup B's 74.62 mm, 1.04 sensor-scale camera, and preserves the complete Redshift and Magic Bullet Looks render chain.

The current v17 proof keeps the 0.3 chin offset, 9.75° jaw, 0.4-unit upper-teeth lift, v7's 0 EV exposure and 3.28 area key, then raises the dome to 1.25 as diffuse-only fill with reflection disabled.

All available earlier passes (v1-v5, v7 and v9-v16) remain preserved as calibration history in the right panel; use v4 for the reusable facial keys, v16 as the literal v7-settings control, and v17 for the filled current pick.
This file derives from the native facial-mocap retarget. The material master and facial-mocap source remain untouched.

retargetSteps.label: Create body mocap
retargetSteps.description: Create an AI Motion Capture project in Wonder Studio and choose the AI Motion Capture template so the MetaHuman actor is available.

retargetSteps.label: Export USD
retargetSteps.description: Export from Wonder Studio as USD and import the file into Blender. The imported scene may initially appear extremely small.

retargetSteps.label: Detach the armature
retargetSteps.description: Select the imported armature, clear its parent, and switch the armature to Rest Position.

retargetSteps.label: Clean root motion
retargetSteps.description: Delete root keyframes, then clear all transforms for static-in-place motion or clear scale only when the character should travel.

retargetSteps.label: Retarget to Abby
retargetSteps.description: Copy the imported armature into the Abby retarget project, build bones in Auto-Rig Pro, keep Set as Root enabled, then run Re-Target.

retargetSteps.label: Attach Quick Rig
retargetSteps.description: Select AbbyRIG_BODY in Auto-Rig Pro Quick Rig, choose the UE Metahuman preset, run Quick Rig, and choose Preserve.

retargetSteps.label: Bake and refine
retargetSteps.description: Bake animation when needed, then use the attached controllers and IK/FK switching to repair noisy mocap.
